1	import { mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
2	import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
3	import { join } from 'node:path'
4	import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
5	import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
6	import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
7	import Loader from '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader'
8	import Include from '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include'
9	import SessionProjectionRegistry from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection'
10	import TokenMeter from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter'
11	import ToolResultPruner from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
12	
13	let root: string | undefined
14	let context: Context | undefined
15	
16	afterEach(async () => {
17	  await context?.fiber.dispose()
18	  context = undefined
19	  if (root !== undefined) await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
20	  root = undefined
21	})
22	
23	describe('compaction-tool-result-pruner real Loader composition', () => {
24	  it('loads and resolves the flat YAML plugin shape', async () => {
25	    root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'dsh-compact-tool-result-prune-loader-'))
26	    const configPath = join(root, 'cordis.yml')
27	    await writeFile(configPath, [
28	      "- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection'",
29	      "- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter'",
30	      "- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'",
31	      '  config:',
32	      '    thresholdChars: 100',
33	      '    headChars: 20',
34	      '    tailChars: 10',
35	      '',
36	    ].join('\n'))
37	
38	    context = new Context()
39	    context.baseUrl = pathToFileURL(root).href + '/'
40	    await context.plugin(Loader)
41	    context.loader.builtins.include = Include
42	    context.loader.internal = {
43	      version: 'v2',
44	      async import(specifier: string) {
45	        if (specifier === '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection') return SessionProjectionRegistry
46	        if (specifier === '@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter') return TokenMeter
47	        if (specifier === '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner') return ToolResultPruner
48	        throw new Error(`unexpected Loader import: ${specifier}`)
49	      },
50	    } as unknown as NonNullable<typeof context.loader.internal>
51	    await context.loader.create({
52	      name: 'cordis:include',
53	      config: { path: pathToFileURL(configPath).href },
54	    })
55	    await context.loader.await()
56	
57	    expect(context.get('toolResultPruner')).toBeInstanceOf(ToolResultPruner)
58	    expect(context.toolResultPruner.config).toEqual({
59	      thresholdChars: 100,
60	      headChars: 20,
61	      tailChars: 10,
62	    })
63	  })
64	
65	  it('rejects stale config after plugin schema normalization', async () => {
66	    context = new Context()
67	    // Satisfy the declared injections first: config normalization runs in the
68	    // service constructor, which a pending fiber never reaches.
69	    await context.plugin(SessionProjectionRegistry)
70	    await context.plugin(TokenMeter)
71	    await expect(context.plugin(ToolResultPruner, {
72	      maxChars: 100,
73	    } as never)).rejects.toThrow(/unknown key "maxChars"/)
74	  })
75	})
